title: Calhoun hits back at reviews

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I'm afraid I have something rather troubling to report.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm afraid I have something rather troubling to report.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Despite my attempts, I can't think of a way to spin this as good news.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Despite my attempts, I can't think of a way to spin this as good news.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It appears you are being review bombed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It appears you are being review bombed.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Well, you have more than a few enemies. But there are several negative rumors given by a user called LIMBS4LIMS...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, you have more than a few enemies. But there are several negative rumors given by a user called LIMBS4LIMS...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: He did threaten to take action, if he was not paid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He did threaten to take action, if he was not paid.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: In the short term? No. The damage is done. In the long term I can try to prevent him from leaving fraudulent reviews, but that will take some time. Or...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In the short term? No. The damage is done. In the long term I can try to prevent him from leaving fraudulent reviews, but that will take some time. Or...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Or you could pay him. I can send him the Lims directly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Or you could pay him. I can send him the Lims directly.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I will try. But I'm afraid your reputation may never be perfect so long as he remains unpaid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will try. But I'm afraid your reputation may never be perfect so long as he remains unpaid.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Affirmative. Your reputation should recover soon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Affirmative. Your reputation should recover soon.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Someone is spreading negative rumors about your establishments. And since the food is not that bad, I can only assume they are malicious...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Someone is spreading negative rumors about your establishments. And since the food is not that bad, I can only assume they are malicious...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: As much as I want to be motivating for you, I don't think this is true. Who do you owe money to?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As much as I want to be motivating for you, I don't think this is true. Who do you owe money to?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This is bribery! Can you do anything?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is bribery! Can you do anything?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This is bribery! Can you do anything?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This is bribery! Can you do anything?
